title: AghaBalaSar and Hamed
statement: Given a permutation p of length n, with n up to 10^6 (sum over tests at most 10^6), one may step from index i to any index on its left or to the nearest index on its right holding a larger value. With f(i,j) the minimum number of steps from i to j (0 if unreachable), compute the sum of f(i,j) over all ordered pairs.
